history.name: Three Markdown documents for the team
history.description: The command ledger build also writes three Markdown documents from the same corpus: FEATURES.md, the client-facing list; FEATURES_EXTENDED.md, the same list with implementation notes under each entry; and DEV_FEATURES.md, the entries only the team sees. All three describe the latest release, so they read as what the product does today. They are build output: the corpus is what you commit, and it carries the documentation's history on its own.
history.dev_notes: src/render/markdown.mjs; the three docs are the three audience/dev_notes combinations. Titles, intros and the colophon are overridable per project under `docs` in config.json — see src/wording.mjs.
